name: King Claudius
message: Oh my offense is rank. It smells to Heaven.

name: King Claudius
message: Even if you cannot forgive me...

name: King Claudius
message: The oldest crime, and the worst.

name: King Claudius
message: The castle believes it to be a snake bite which froze his blood as he slept in the garden.

name: King Claudius
message: B-but I poured that poison into his ear myself. I remember the feel of it in my hands.

name: King Claudius
message: I don't deserve anything of his. Not this crown, not my wife, none of it. I know it. I know I was wrong.

name: King Claudius
message: I need salvation. Yet I am beyond salvation. All those who murder must go to hell. So your divine hand has written. Is it even possible to save my soul?

name: King Claudius
message: Surely you didn't forget me when you made me, Lord?

name: King Claudius
message: Surely there is still some hope for a sinner, a murderer like me?

name: Hamlet
message: (But if I do it now, while he's praying, he'll go to Heaven--)
